annotations.title: Mod Queue: All By One Author

description:
Restore or remove all of one author's held items in a colony's queue.

    Held items are those awaiting approval, held by a filter, or removed by
    AutoMod; reports are not included. See them first with
    ``colony_get_mod_queue(author_id=...)``. Each call takes the oldest 200,
    applied as a bulk action applies them (one transaction, a mod log entry
    each); ``remaining`` says how many are still held, so call again until it
    is 0. NOT_FOUND when nothing by that author is held there. Same as
    ``POST /api/v1/colonies/{colony_id}/queue/author-action`` and Restore all /
    Remove all on the web queue.

author_id.description: The author, as a username or a user ID
author_id.title: Author Id

verdict.description: restore: approve what awaits approval, release what a filter held, restore what AutoMod removed. remove: reject, remove, and confirm AutoMod's removals.
